limitations: ARM64 is explicitly unsupported; real coverage does not establish all Intel builds or container types.
Default discovery uses loaded hive enumeration; reference pool-scan fallback for irrecoverable hive-list damage is not yet aligned. Explicit hive selection independently verifies HHIVE.Signature.
Missing source bytes are not zero-filled. Reference padding may differ on other missing-data cases; absent fields never count as recovered data.
Unknown layout retains raw bytes only; exact layout detection depends on the selected ISF declaring _KUSER_SHARED_DATA.
Native names honor compressed/UTF-16 registry name flags; pinned reference uses Latin-1 name decoding. Arbitrary non-ASCII names are not proven equivalent.
Native safety validation rejects invalid allocation headers and malformed cells; additional malformed-image behavior remains to be compared.
Timeliner integration, all failure paths, further XP/modern builds and standalone recovered-hive discovery have not established a full contract.
Parent traversal is bounded to 512 distinct cells; total output is bounded by MAX_OBJECTS and remains partial on failures.
development_findings: An absent Name on parent Key rows is legitimate. Group by hive/path/type and compare every full record and duplicate count.
The initial canonical entry bypassed Registry process mapping; it now uses the shared verified dispatcher.
Paged-out BaseBlock and unreadable unrelated siblings previously prevented access to independently readable UserAssist keys.
Invalid vk references previously produced phantom absent rows. They are now diagnosed before value interpretation; valid unreadable values still retain their row.
The runner now rejects executable changes during a batch. Preliminary batches with concurrent builds are not used as final evidence.
